description: Official SVG geometry used by the approved Aino notification design. Brand assets and specialty icons keep their original sources.
changes: SVG element attributes normalized for React; icon path geometry is unchanged.

mappingRationale.ArrowRightUp: External link affordance uses the official external-link glyph.
mappingRationale.BookmarkFilled: The active bookmark state uses the official pinned glyph.
mappingRationale.Command: This export opens Command Center, so it uses the official dashboard glyph.
mappingRationale.Pound: Count/version data uses the official numeric symbol.
mappingRationale.Keyboard: keyboard is an official alias of record-keys in the installed mapping.json.
mappingRationale.ListAdd: This export queues a message; the official list-selection glyph denotes the queued list.

Sun.reason: Installed Codicons 0.0.45 has no sun glyph; the distinct light-mode choice must remain recognizable.

Moon.reason: Installed Codicons 0.0.45 has no moon glyph; the distinct dark-mode choice must remain recognizable.

Power.reason: Installed Codicons 0.0.45 has no power glyph. This symbol covers gateway restart and app quit; replacing it with stop or disconnect would change its meaning.

VoiceOff.reason: Installed Codicons has a microphone and a muted speaker, but no crossed microphone. Retain the correct microphone-off meaning.

SoundWave.reason: Installed Codicons has no waveform glyph. This symbol identifies voice conversation and speech playback.

TwoDimensionalCode.reason: Installed Codicons has no QR-code glyph; retain the scannable-code action.

Egg.reason: Product specialty symbol without an official equivalent.

SteeringWheel.reason: Product specialty symbol without an official equivalent.

compatibilityNormalization: Legacy compatibility paths retain their source and distinct semantics, scaled into the same 16-unit viewport with one-pixel optical strokes at 16px. They are not labeled official Codicons.
